source.note: User requested 1998 Leaf Certified Football, but the supplied TCDB link is the 1999 Leaf Certified set. Set Factory follows the linked set. Checklist structure, teams, insert families, serial-number tiers, and published insertion rates were cross-checked against TCDB.

decisions.baseTierModeling: The physical base set has four scarcity tiers (#1-100 four per pack; #101-150 one per pack; #151-175 1:3 packs; #176-225 rookies 1:5 packs). The current VCS engine has one BASE ProductSet and therefore cannot enforce range-specific base-card odds. Historical tier information is preserved in card variant metadata; all 225 base cards remain in one VCS base pool.
decisions.mirrorRedModeling: Mirror Red has range-specific historical odds (#1-100 1:17, #101-150 1:53, #151-175 1:125, #176-225 1:89). A single ProductSet cannot encode four rates, so oddsPerPack is intentionally null and the historical ratios are retained in notes.
decisions.mirrorGoldModeling: Mirror Gold is a full 225-card parallel with serial-number tiers: #1-100 SN45, #101-150 SN35, #151-175 SN25, #176-225 rookies SN30. Explicit CSV rows preserve the correct tier per card.
decisions.fabricModeling: Fabric of the Game uses three 25-card material groups. Serial-number tiers are stored on each card. TCDB's release-note prose contains overlapping range typos in two blocks, so card-level tier assignment follows the non-overlapping repeated 25-card pattern visible in the checklist: positions 1-3 SN100, 4-7 SN250, 8-12 SN500, 13-18 SN750, 19-25 SN1000 within each material block.
derivedSets: Certified Gold Future Mirror Black derives from Certified Gold Future; SN25
Certified Gold Team Mirror Black derives from Certified Gold Team; SN25
Certified Skills Mirror Black derives from Certified Skills; SN25
Gridiron Gear NFL Shield derives from Gridiron Gear; MEM NFL Shield; SN1
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased because VCS cannot faithfully represent base-tier and Mirror Red range-specific odds with the current ProductSet-level odds model, and several memorabilia/parallel pack rates are not reliably published.
